I saved Brackenwater Freight Co.'s next renewal date (25 November) to the shared brain, with Ilse's #north-team message as the source. I also confirmed it in a thread reply to that message.

I couldn't check the date against anything. There are no Brackenwater files on the share, and nothing in the brain gives a renewal date for them. The brain's search was keyword-only, so it could have missed records worded differently.

The date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to confirm it in the channel. I didn't take any other action, since Ilse said none was needed.
